title: Grief-resolution rooms mix two kinds of options with no visual distinction: some actions are clearly exploratory (loot, lore, side-NPC requests) and some are the actual one-shot ending trigger, but nothing marks which is which until after you've picked it. I resolved both Iron Downs ('speak the truth over the Hundred') and Fenmarch ('ring the saint's bell out over the water') as 'rested' purely by pursuing side-quest dialogue/items, without ever seeing an explicit rest-vs-burn menu the way Thornwold's Gallows Glade or the Kings' Rest presented one.
where: The Hundred Gallery — Deep / 'speak the truth over the Hundred'; The Drowned Nave / 'ring the saint's bell out over the water'
